ONNX Runtime HarmonyOS arm64 build

Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.26.0
Upstream commit: 8c546c37b43caaca1fa25db430dab94b901cf277
Target SDK: HarmonyOS Native SDK 26.0.0.105
Target triple: aarch64-linux-ohos26.0.0
Compiler: HarmonyOS Clang 15.0.4
Provider profile: CPU
Compatibility profile: BF16 and NEON FP16 acceleration paths disabled for this compiler; general CPU kernels retained.
SONAME: libonnxruntime.so
DT_NEEDED: libdeviceinfo_ndk.z.so, libc++_shared.so, libc.so

The runtime was compiled against the target SDK sysroot. Device-side loading remains unverified because no HarmonyOS device was connected during this build.
